passage: Renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power have gained popularity in recent decades. Unlike fossil fuels, renewable resources can be replenished naturally and produce less pollution. Many countries are investing in renewable energy to reduce dependence on oil and coal. Although renewable technologies can be expensive to develop initially, supporters argue that long-term environmental and economic benefits outweigh the costs. As technology improves, renewable energy may become even more accessible and efficient.
